final_summary:
**Summary — CASE-011**

- **Classification:** `missing_ledger_entry`
- **What I found:** The case is bank-only. BNK-0086 (2026-08-19) is an ACH debit of USD 2,169.31 referencing BILL-5057, payee "Adams, Zuniga and Wong". A reference search for BILL-5057 returns one bank line and **no** ledger entries, and the reference isn't matched anywhere else. DOC-010, the vendor bill, shows BILL-5057 from Adams, Zuniga and Wong for exactly USD 2,169.31 (issued 2026-07-28, due 2026-08-27) — amount, payee and reference all agree with the bank line.
- **Why not something else:** Only one bank line and no ledger rows, so it can't be a duplicate; the amount matches a real vendor bill, so it isn't a bank fee; both sides are USD, so no FX element; and it cleared within the statement period, so it isn't a timing difference.
- **Proposed fix (pending human approval, nothing posted):** Debit 2000 Accounts Payable 2,169.31 / Credit 1000 Cash - Operating 2,169.31 to record the payment of BILL-5057. Proposal ID PROP-01E14CC5.
